description: Pipedrive for an agent: search and read deals, people, organizations, activities, notes, pipelines and stages; create and update people, organizations and deals, move a deal's stage, mark it won or lost, log activities and notes, and delete, with every write governed.

actions.name: search-deals
actions.description: Search deals by title, notes and custom fields. Returns up to 20 matches a page, each with id, title, value, currency, status, stage, owner, person and organization. Filter by person, organization or status. When additional_data.next_cursor is present, pass it as cursor for the next page. Pipedrive caps a filtered search at 2000 deals.

term.description: What to search for, at least 2 characters.

exact_match.description: true to match the whole term exactly (not case sensitive).

person_id.description: Deals of this person (an id from search-persons).

organization_id.description: Deals of this organization (an id from search-organizations).

cursor.description: additional_data.next_cursor from the previous page. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: search-persons
actions.description: Search people by name, email, phone, notes and custom fields. Returns up to 20 matches a page, each with id, name, emails, phones, owner and organization. Filter by organization. When additional_data.next_cursor is present, pass it as cursor for the next page.

term.description: What to search for, at least 2 characters.

exact_match.description: true to match the whole term exactly (not case sensitive).

organization_id.description: People of this organization (an id from search-organizations).

cursor.description: additional_data.next_cursor from the previous page. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: search-organizations
actions.description: Search organizations by name, address, notes and custom fields. Returns up to 20 matches a page, each with id, name, address and owner. When additional_data.next_cursor is present, pass it as cursor for the next page.

term.description: What to search for, at least 2 characters.

exact_match.description: true to match the whole term exactly (not case sensitive).

cursor.description: additional_data.next_cursor from the previous page. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: list-deals
actions.description: List deals, 20 a page, filtered by owner, person, organization, pipeline, stage, status or last update. Without status it returns open, won and lost deals; status deleted returns deals deleted in the last 30 days. Archived deals are not listed. Each deal has its id, title, value, currency, status, pipeline, stage, person, organization and dates. When additional_data.next_cursor is present, pass it as cursor for the next page.

owner_id.description: Deals owned by this Pipedrive user id.

pipeline_id.description: Deals in this pipeline (an id from list-pipelines).

stage_id.description: Deals in this stage (an id from list-stages).

updated_since.description: Deals updated at or after this time, RFC 3339 in UTC, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

sort_by.description: Sort field. Pipedrive's default is id.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction. Pipedrive's default is asc.

cursor.description: additional_data.next_cursor from the previous page. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: get-deal
actions.description: Get one deal: title, value, currency, status, pipeline and stage, person, organization, owner, dates, lost reason and custom field values (keyed by the field's hash).

deal_id.description: The deal's id, from search-deals or list-deals.

actions.name: get-person
actions.description: Get one person: name, emails, phones, organization, owner, labels and custom field values (keyed by the field's hash).

actions.name: get-organization
actions.description: Get one organization: name, address, owner, labels and custom field values (keyed by the field's hash).

actions.name: list-activities
actions.description: List activities (calls, meetings, tasks and other types), 20 a page, filtered by owner, deal, person, organization or done. Each has its id, subject, type, due date and time, duration, done, and the deal, person and organization it is linked to. When additional_data.next_cursor is present, pass it as cursor for the next page.

owner_id.description: Activities owned by this Pipedrive user id.

person_id.description: Activities whose primary participant is this person.

done.description: true for done activities, false for open ones.

sort_by.description: Sort field. Pipedrive's default is id.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction. Pipedrive's default is asc.

cursor.description: additional_data.next_cursor from the previous page. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: get-activity
actions.description: Get one activity: subject, type, due date and time, duration, done, note, and the deal, person and organization it is linked to.

actions.name: list-pipelines
actions.description: List the company's pipelines, 50 a page: id, name and order. When additional_data.next_cursor is present, pass it as cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: additional_data.next_cursor from the previous page. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: list-stages
actions.description: List stages, 50 a page, of one pipeline or of all: id, name, order in the pipeline and pipeline_id. A deal's stage_id is one of these. When additional_data.next_cursor is present, pass it as cursor for the next page.

pipeline_id.description: Stages of this pipeline (an id from list-pipelines).

cursor.description: additional_data.next_cursor from the previous page. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: list-notes
actions.description: List notes, 10 a page, on one deal, person or organization, or all of them. Each has its id, content (HTML), author and the deal, person and organization it is on. Pages with start: when additional_data.pagination.more_items_in_collection is true, pass additional_data.pagination.next_start as start. A long note can be cut at the response limit.

start.description: additional_data.pagination.next_start from the previous page. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: get-note
actions.description: Get one note: its content (HTML), author, dates and the deal, person and organization it is on.

actions.name: create-person
actions.description: Create one person with a name and a work email, and optionally phones, an organization and an owner. Read back by person id; the name and the email must match. Limitation: Pipedrive accepts two people with the same email, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second one. Search with search-persons before you create one.

phones.description: The phone numbers, each { value, primary, label }. Mark one primary.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary one.

org_id.description: The organization they work at (an id from search-organizations).

owner_id.description: The Pipedrive user id who owns the person. Leave out for the key's own user.

actions.name: update-person
actions.description: Update one person's name, emails, phones, organization or owner. Only the fields you pass change; emails and phones are sent as the full list you give. Read back by person id; the name, organization and owner must equal what Pipedrive returned for the update. Limitation: emails and phones are not part of the read-back.

emails.description: The email addresses, each { value, primary, label }. Mark one primary.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary one.

phones.description: The phone numbers, each { value, primary, label }. Mark one primary.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary one.

owner_id.description: The Pipedrive user id who owns the person.

actions.name: delete-person
actions.description: Delete one person. Pipedrive marks the person deleted and removes them for good after 30 days. No read-back: Pipedrive does not document how a read shows a person in those 30 days, so the receipt is acknowledged. Check with get-person.

actions.name: create-organization
actions.description: Create one organization with a name and optionally an owner. Read back by organization id; the name must match. Limitation: Pipedrive accepts two organizations with the same name, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second one. Search with search-organizations before you create one.

owner_id.description: The Pipedrive user id who owns it. Leave out for the key's own user.

actions.name: create-deal
actions.description: Create one open deal with a title, and optionally a person, an organization, a pipeline and stage, a value and currency, an owner and an expected close date. Pipedrive chooses the pipeline and stage when they are left out. The value records what the deal is worth; no money moves. Read back by deal id; the title must match. Limitation: no idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second deal.

person_id.description: The person on the deal (an id from search-persons).

org_id.description: The organization on the deal (an id from search-organizations).

value.description: What the deal is worth, in currency units (not cents).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD. Pipedrive uses the company's default when left out.

owner_id.description: The Pipedrive user id who owns the deal. Leave out for the key's own user.

actions.name: update-deal
actions.description: Update one deal's title, value, currency, owner, expected close date, person or organization. Only the fields you pass change. Use move-deal-stage for the stage and set-deal-status for won or lost. Read back by deal id; the title, value, currency and owner must equal what Pipedrive returned for the update. Limitation: the close date, person and organization are not part of the read-back.

deal_id.description: The deal's id, from search-deals or list-deals.

value.description: What the deal is worth, in currency units (not cents).

owner_id.description: The Pipedrive user id who owns the deal.

actions.name: move-deal-stage
actions.description: Move one deal to another stage. Stage ids come from list-stages. Read back by deal id; the deal's stage must be the one given.

deal_id.description: The deal's id, from search-deals or list-deals.

stage_id.description: The stage to move it to (an id from list-stages).

actions.name: set-deal-status
actions.description: Mark one deal won or lost, or reopen it. A lost reason can be given with lost only (Pipedrive's rule). Read back by deal id; the status must be the one given.

deal_id.description: The deal's id, from search-deals or list-deals.

status.description: won, lost, or open to reopen it.

lost_reason.description: Why it was lost. Only with status lost.

actions.name: delete-deal
actions.description: Delete one deal. Pipedrive marks it deleted and removes it for good after 30 days; until then it can be restored in Pipedrive. Read back from the deals deleted in the last 30 days; this deal must be among them.

deal_id.description: The deal's id, from search-deals or list-deals.

actions.name: create-activity
actions.description: Create one activity (a call, meeting, task or another type the company has) with a subject and a type, linked to a deal or an organization, optionally due at a date and time, with a note. Read back by activity id; the subject and type must match. Limitations: a person is linked through the deal, not directly; and there is no idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second activity.

subject.description: What the activity is, e.g. Call about the renewal.

type.description: The activity type's key: call, meeting, task, deadline, email, lunch, or a type the company added.

deal_id.description: The deal it is for (an id from search-deals).

owner_id.description: The Pipedrive user id it is assigned to. Leave out for the key's own user.

actions.name: complete-activity
actions.description: Mark one activity done. Read back by activity id; done must be true.

actions.name: add-note
actions.description: Add one note to a deal, a person or an organization. Give at least one of deal_id, person_id and org_id, or Pipedrive refuses it. The content is HTML, which Pipedrive sanitizes. Read back by note id; the stored content must equal what Pipedrive returned. Limitation: no idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can add a second note.

content.description: The note, as plain text or HTML.

deal_id.description: The deal to put it on.

person_id.description: The person to put it on.

org_id.description: The organization to put it on.

policies.name: pipedrive: approve marking a deal won or lost

limits.name: pipedrive: deal stage moves per day
pipedrive: deals marked won or lost per day
